lead: `wasmtime-wasi` and `wasmtime-wasi-http` cannot be dependencies: both pull `tokio` with `rt` and `time`, and `wasmtime-wasi` runs its filesystem on tokio's blocking pool.
body: `crates/nvs-runtime/tests/manifest_policy.rs`'s `tokio_appears_in_neither_the_manifest_nor_the_lockfile` fails on the lock file alone (`rule:concurrency/one-scheduler`), and only the full `nv verify` runs it, so a crate's own tests pass first. A guest's WASI is generated with `wasmtime::component::bindgen!` over `wit/nvs-ext/deps/` and implemented in `nvs-ext`, with `wasi:io` mapped to `wasmtime-wasi-io`, which has no tokio.
